title: api-evangelist/roboflow
description: Roboflow is a computer vision platform used by over one million engineers to annotate images, train custom models, and deploy them to production from the cloud to the edge. The platform spans dataset management and AI-assisted labeling, model training (RF-DETR, YOLO and NAS architectures), evaluation with mAP and confusion-matrix analysis, and…
